findings.evidence: Gluing.lean:136-148 builds `SmoothPartitionOfUnity.exists_isSubordinate` + `finite_nonempty_inter_compact` + `sum_finsupport'` inline. PartitionOfUnity.lean:103 runs `exists_isSubordinate` the same way.
findings.fix: Make it a public lemma in `TestFunction/PartitionOfUnity.lean`, for example `IsCompact.exists_finset_contDiff_sum_eq_one`. Use it in `existsUnique_gluing`, and in `exists_sum_subordinate` if that fits, which brings the main proof under 50 lines.
findings.issue: `hcut` is a reusable fact buried inside the ~58-line `existsUnique_gluing` proof (lines 129–186). It says a compact `K ⊆ ⋃ U i` has finitely many `C^n` cutoffs, each with `tsupport` inside `U i`, that sum to one on `K`. It repeats the partition-of-unity construction of `exists_sum_subordinate` (PartitionOfUnity.lean:98–109).

findings.evidence: Grep finds `by_cases hx : x ∈ tsupport φ` at Gluing.lean:87 and PartitionOfUnity.lean:113, and `by_cases hx : x ∈ tsupport ψ` at Gluing.lean:182, each followed by the same two `simp` calls.
findings.fix: Factor out one lemma, e.g. `sum_smul_eq_self_of_sum_eq_one (φ) (h : ∀ x ∈ tsupport φ, ∑ i ∈ s, c i x = 1) : ∑ i ∈ s, c i x • φ x = φ x`, or a `cutoffCLM`-level version. Use it at all three places.
findings.issue: The same argument appears three times: if `∑ c i = 1` on `tsupport φ`, then `∑ i, c i x • φ x = φ x`, shown by `by_cases hx : x ∈ tsupport φ` with `simp [← Finset.sum_smul, …]` / `simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx]`. The copies are at Gluing.lean:86-89 (`hsplit`), Gluing.lean:179-183 (end of `hglue`), and PartitionOfUnity.lean:111-117.

findings.evidence: Mathlib TestFunction.lean:446 (`postcompCLM`) discharges the same obligation with `(fun _ _ _ ↦ by ext; simp [Φ])` instead of `rfl`.
findings.fix: Use `(fun _ _ _ ↦ by ext; simp [ContDiffMapSupportedIn.coe_of_support_subset])`, following Mathlib's analogous `postcompCLM`, or add a comment explaining why `rfl` is intended here.
findings.issue: The compatibility argument `toFun_eq_T` of `limitCLM` is closed by `(fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl)` with no comment. This depends on definitional unfolding through `ofSupportedIn`, `ofSupportedInCLM`, the hand-built `M`, and `ContDiffMapSupportedIn.of_support_subset`.

summary: The proofs are sound and mostly robust, but `existsUnique_gluing` (about 58 lines) has a reusable cutoff-existence fact buried inside it. The same 'cutoffs summing to one reproduce φ' argument is written out three times, and `cutoffCLM` closes its compatibility obligation with an undocumented `rfl` that goes through several wrappers.
